children: and US private investment firm CD&R are in talks to acquire chemicals maker Ashland
in an all-cash deal valuing the company at about $3.39 billion, Bloomberg News reported on Sunday, citing people familiar with the matter.
Clariant and Ashland declined to comment on the report. CD&R could not immediately be reached for comment.
No final decision has been made on the deal, which would value the company close to its share price on Friday, and discussions could fall through or another suitor could still emerge, the report said
In July, Ashland put itself up for sale after coming under pressure from activist investors who said the company was undervalued
Private equity firms including Advent, Apollo Global Management
have also had contact with the US chemical maker
